messages:
mika: putting up PR #4139 — migration guide for SDK v0.9 -> v1.0, refreshed snippets for Python/TS, and a short examples appendix. Planning to merge in today's docs window (16:00 PT). reviewers?
alex: I can take a look. main checklist: terminology swap (tenant -> workspace), avoid 'customers' where we mean SDK users, and prefer present-tense instructional voice.
jess: Quick tone check later. Also watch for passive voice in the migration steps.
olivia: I'll do the code examples. flag: please don't include inline API keys in examples. use `Client.from_env()` or a credentials loader.
mika: updated examples to `Client.from_env()` and added a small env var note. also added a before/after table for route config changes and a short note about model routing fallback behavior.
ci-bot: Preview build failing: linkcheck error in migration.md -> anchor 'routing-fallbacks' not found.
mika: doh, must have renamed that header. fixing anchor and re-pushing.
docs-preview-bot: Preview ready: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4139 — please scan code blocks, headings, and the migration table rendering.
jess: quick pass: suggested changing imperative checklist items to gentler phrasing (e.g., "Run this script" -> "You can run this script"). also replace 'simple' with 'straightforward' in the explanatory copy per style guide.
olivia: snippet feedback: streaming example should use generator-style consumer. change:
```python
with client.stream_chat(prompt) as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text)
```
to:
```python
for chunk in client.stream_chat(prompt):
    print(chunk.text)
```
This avoids implying a context-manager that controls network lifetimes.
mika: switched to generator loop and added a comment about backpressure/flow control. tightened the rollback steps in the runbook and added explicit example command.
alex: I pushed a minor edit to align wording with the glossary (workspace vs tenant). Left one non-blocking nit about punctuation in a bulleted example.
jess: I flagged a tiny grammar nit & a heading level mismatch (H3 should be H2 in the appendix). Not blocking.
docs-preview-bot: Updated preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4139 — markdown rendering looks good, table responsive.
ci-bot: CI: docs build succeeded with 0 warnings.
 olivia: approving now, left a small suggestion which is optional (clarify example error message).
alex: approved. @jess @mika final pass? planning to merge at 16:10 PT after the merge-window buffer.
jess: approved from my side. moved the punctuation nit to a suggestion.
mika: thanks all — merging at 16:10 PT unless I hear objections.
alex: merged PR #4139 :tada: — nice work, docs look clearer and the tone edits read much better for developer audience.
